paragraphs.source_en: That day you roamed lightly through the reaches of the sky, free, weightless; you had never meant to linger at that edge of heaven or that corner of earth; your happiness was an unbarred wandering at ease. Still less did you notice that on the humble ground there was a runnel of stream-water; though your radiance, as you passed, touched and tinted his airy clarity, startling him awake, so that he clasped your lovely shadow tight. What he clasped was only a close-woven grief, because beauty cannot stand still amid the scenery; He longed, yet you had already flown beyond ten thousand mountain crests, going to cast your shadow upon broader lakes and seas! He is growing thin for you, that runnel of stream-water, in powerless longing, longing for you to fly back!
